cadence_note: steps.csv holds 8000 rows; the morph column is forward-filled between measurements, so the 320 rows on the measurement grid (offset 1, stride 25) are the actual readings. Every statistic below is computed on those, never on the filled rows.
J_k_note: J is computed on the series 3a WILL ACTUALLY THRESHOLD. At k>1 that is the trailing median of the last k readings, whose step-to-step noise is roughly J_raw/sqrt(k); comparing M against the RAW J would over-constrain by ~2.8x at k=8 and could send a viable 3a to UNCALIBRABLE for no reason. The first k-1 readings are DROPPED, matching the detector's refusal to evaluate on a partial window. A CLARIFICATION of the criterion, not a change to it -- and legitimate only because k is declared BEFORE M.
J_note: median |change| between CONSECUTIVE READINGS (25 steps apart at --morph-every 25). A LOWER BOUND on the noise in the paired difference 3a thresholds, not that noise itself.
J_early_note: the criterion window (2000-8000) measures SETTLED jitter. A collapse, if it happens, happens EARLY -- which is exactly where 3a operates. J_early is a SANITY CHECK to look at before writing M down; M_DECLARABLE is still computed from the 2000-8000 window and is NOT affected by it.
k_caution: MEASURED, and it matters if k>1 is declared. Smoothing reduces J MUCH more than the ~sqrt(k) the criterion's rationale assumed: consecutive trailing medians share k-1 of their k inputs, so the SMOOTHED series' step-to-step change collapses (measured ~11x at k=8, ~5x at k=4, against sqrt(k) = 2.8 and 2.0) while its LEVEL noise -- the thing that could actually hold a 500-step false streak -- falls only about sqrt(k). Compare J_reduction_factor_at_k against iqr_reduction_factor_at_k: if J has fallen far more than the IQR, the criterion has been satisfied by autocorrelation rather than by real noise reduction. NOT ACTED ON HERE -- the criterion is pre-registered and this file does not change it. Flagged so the k decision is made with the number visible.
criterion: declare M iff a candidate with M >= 3.0*J can be chosen while M <= 0.24814688; i.e. iff 3.0*J <= 0.24814688, with J measured on the k=1 series 3a will threshold
m_ceiling_note: 0.24814688 is roughly 60% of the whole-pool headroom over chance (0.0657). An M above it would only fire in territory 3b already covers.
verdict: AT k=1: DECLARE M in [0.0974, 0.24814688] and hash it before arm 2.
k_ordering_constraint: if J is borderline, --abort3-median-window k > 1 may be used, and k MUST BE DECLARED BEFORE M. A window chosen after a candidate M is on the table has been selected to make that M work.
